data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned an inconclusive verdict solely because it encountered an HTTP 400 error when attempting to audit .gitignore. The deepseek model successfully audited .gitignore and correctly identified it as a standard, benign file. There is no actual security disagreement between the models.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .gitignore due to an HTTP 400 API error.
learnings: The audit tool should differentiate between critical files (PKGBUILD, .install, patches) and non-critical files (.gitignore, editor configs) when handling partial audit failures. A failure to audit a non-executable file like .gitignore should not force an overall inconclusive verdict if the critical packaging files are verified safe.
